people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Beth-rehob
people.line: Aramean city and region, allied with Ammon against David.

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

people.name: Tob
people.line: Region where Jephthah fled and recruited mercenaries

people.name: Zobah
people.line: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign

translations.web: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate. The Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob, and the men of Tob and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.
translations.bsb: The Ammonites marched out and arrayed themselves for battle at the entrance of the city gate, while the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob and the men of Tob and Maacah were by themselves in the open country.
translations.kjv: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ishtob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.
translations.asv: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entrance of the gate: and the Syrians of Zobah and of Rehob, and the men of Tob and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.
